test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Eight girls - Ponti, Bobby, Anshu, Renu, Mohini, Sujata, Rani and Mohita are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table (but not necessarily in the same order). Some of them are sitting at the corners while some are sitting exactly in the middle of the sides. Ponti is sitting sixth to the left of Bobby, who is sitting third to the right of Sujata. Mohini is sitting second to the left of Sujata. Rani is sitting right next to Ponti and Bobby. Anshu is sitting immediate left of Sujata, who is sitting immediate left of Renu. 

Who is sitting immediate right of Rani?
solution:
Given: Eight girls - Ponti, Bobby, Anshu, Renu, Mohini, Sujata, Rani and Mohita are sitting around a square table facing the centre of the table. 

1) Ponti is sitting sixth to the left of **Bobby, who** is sitting third to the right of Sujata. 

2) Rani is sitting right next to Ponti and Bobby.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a534326c3716e9750ae395115a5a28b59b0518a4c0633adae2035e00280796af.png] 

3) Mohini is sitting second to the left of Sujata.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b83aadfa001308116c450f00dacce4551e80218460e8bcd17fc5a5ab9038ffa.png] 

4) Anshu is sitting immediate left of **Sujata, who** is sitting immediate left of Renu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/465414241798e6bf8969f328f6f39d176d870dee7ffbae0fb0658dcc4849c2fc.png] 

Then final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/60e58d038336880a60576bc2ee9f00f867877e9980631fac266441df016afc2a.png] 

So, **Ponti**** **is sitting immediate right of Rani.

Hence, the correct answer is "Ponti".
